items.text:
Steep entry level - but very rewarding. 
Dystopian space-sim, surprisingly immersive (even with the perspective and graphics). 
The writing and atmosphere around it is fantastic - helps you get immersed with the world and get into character. The NPC dialogue system is innovative, yet a bit tiring after playing with it a bit.
I LOVE that the game instructions come as "paper manuals" - it's something i rarely see in games, yet it scores even more points for immersion.

After NEO Scavenger, very good team developemt and brave production decisions. I like where the game is heading and can't wait for more content.
items.text_zh:
入门门槛很高——但非常有回报。
反乌托邦太空模拟，出乎意料地有沉浸感（即使考虑到视角和画面）。
围绕它的文本和氛围非常棒——帮助你沉浸在这个世界里并进入角色。NPC对话系统很有创新性，但玩了一会儿后有点累人。
我喜欢游戏说明是以“纸质手册”的形式呈现的——这是我在游戏里很少见到的，但它为沉浸感加了更多分。

在《NEO Scavenger》之后，非常出色的团队开发和勇敢的制作决策。我喜欢这个游戏的发展方向，迫不及待想要更多内容。
